notes.title: Update 1.6.3 - Part 3 Final Modifiers and VFX Overhaul
notes.notes:
Hello again! This update finalises the changes to modifiers and introduces a new visual effect for all dropped items. 



The final two modifiers allow enemies to rearm traps and summon walls to block your path. Some enemies will now fire a projectile at a spent trap to rearm it. This means that areas where you previously avoided traps are no longer safe. 



Conversely, we have introduced enemies that can spawn walls in your path, forcing you to take a different route through the dungeons.



Several fixes have also been made to the logic to ensure the game runs smoothly. 



VFX Overhaul is now finished: every modifier now has a unique updated VFX to make them stand out.

Vampire

In addition to these VFX, we have also enhanced the VFX of all items that are dropped by enemies.

These VFX are colour-coded according to item category. Previously, the outline effect was used for this purpose, but we have expanded upon it to make identification easier.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/9d797a41b4f5c1f0329def559b751e37b6539da3.png"]









Alongside these visual updates we have imporoved the event handling specifically for the multiplayer, so there are fewer synchronisation errors.

notes.title: Update Showcase: Modifiers Part 2
notes.notes:
Hello again, the next update is just around the corner, so we wanted to give you an idea of what to expect.

We have added 2 new modifiers and associated abilities, these are the Vampire and Static Shock modifiers.

The Static Shock modifier is designed to spice up the play style of the game, when an enemy with it takes ranged damage they will fire 2 projectiles that will bounce off nearby walls and floors (take a shield), when they take melee damage they will damage the player for 1 damage, after taking damage they will go on a cooldown. Enemies with the Vampire modifier will periodically fire a projectile that will restore some of their health, so keep your distance. After the projectile is fired, the ability will cooldown.

As always, thank you for reading and we hope you continue to enjoy playing :)

notes.title: Update 1.6.3 Part 1
notes.notes:
This Update is part 1 of 3 and brings the first 3 new enemy modifiers into the game!

The new modifiers are:


 Misty Step
 Mirage
 Hoarder




Misty step
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/93835c98ce6fa448ebd1a29f9bd78bc77a4c6015.png

As we've mentioned in the past, this modifier will allow enemies to teleport behind you, so stay aware of your surroundings


 Mirage 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/eb4496069c9e3167da4840552fdaf9d0e0937b93.png

These enemies will spawn replicas of themselves, the replicas are easily killed, but can pose a significant threat in later stages


Hoarder
This modifier makes enemies drop some extra loot when killed

Once all 3 parts of this update have released, the accompanied effects for every modifier will recieve a massive overhaul.


Alongside these additions weve made the following changes:


 fixed an issue with the bossfights where the spawned enemies would not damage the boss if hit

 moved all spawned objects (enemies, items, weapons, loot) over to a new system, allowing for better sync in multiplayer games

 several smaller fixes 


Thats it for this update, have fun playing!

This Update will be split into several smaller updates, but all parts serve as a big content update to the game, starting with 2 of 6 upcoming new enemy modifiers, each modifier giving enemies a unique ability

notes.title: Update 1.6.1- Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
This update made some QoL changes to the game :

Changes:


 Improved Performance by switching to Singlepass Rendering
 Added back the Greyscale effect when you're dead
 Removed Bloom from the camera
 Improved Performance of Minimap
 Changed Teleporter to next level into new portal object
 Several smaller fixes 


Additions:

Save & Quit feature (Currently Singleplayer only):
After a boss is killed, the green level-change portal and the blue Save & Quit portal will activate. Entering it will save and quit the game back to the Lobby if you want to continue at a later point. Loading the game will load the next level in the loop.

notes.title: Update 1.5 - Performance and Stability
notes.notes:
This patch addresses some long-standing quality of life issues.


Significantly improved game startup speed and loading times when entering a dungeon
Added the option to enable a vignette when you move, to reduce motion sickness
Removed multiplayer drop-in. This was done out of technical reasons, as it sadly was not implemented properly.
Fixed loading screen flickering
Improved haptic feedback for various actions
Added detailed error tracking

notes.title: Update 1.42 - Performance and Controls
notes.notes:
There were some performance problems in the game, especially in the snow area. We significantly improved that and the game should run way better now.

We also fixed the ongoing problems with the oculus controls and added a better control scheme for WMR.

Changelog

Significantly improved performance
Fixed oculus controllers
Added experimental WMR controls

notes.title: Update day!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This update has a lot of quality of life updates and major technical/performance updates. Many bugs have been fixed and almost every aspect of the game has been polished.

Some highlights are:

We have greatly improved loading times, especially between loops. This also fixes a bug where a player would be thrown back to the lobby while the game was loading.

We have improved the combat system and polished combat elements, e.g. enemies have a new death animation and overall all weapons feel better to use.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/144ad09561227aab453a968864979d0bd9c7e684.gif

We improved the visuals of the environments and added new effects to some objects, e.g. destructibles such as crates and vases have now physics and it feels better to destroy them. We also improved the lightning.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/512ddfeee4c11162795225eb1e4c5a3cd122bab5.gif

We support now the valve index controllers. We fixed the oculus controllers and improved the locomotion system. 

We have now a networked lobby, which is not limited to a region. This means if you are connected to the internet and start the game, there is a chance to see other players in the lobby. You can invite players to a group and play with them. We have implemented a reconnect system in case someone disconnects. We still support drop in multiplayer.

---

We wish you all a lot of fun!

Patch Notes:

- Improved loading times (game startup & ingame)
- Improved Performance
- Improved item interactions -> picking up, etc.
- Valve Index Controller Support
- Fixed Oculus Touch Controlls
- Better Enemy Death Animations
- Better Weapon handling (hand position, effects, etc.)
- Improved VFX (Weapons, Projectiles, Companions, Enemies)
- Networked Lobby

notes.title: Snow Area Update
notes.notes:
Today we are ready to release the snow area, which is an open environment. It offers new content, such as new enemies, new traps and a new boss fight. 

In addition to that we fixed some issues and rebalanced some items.

We lowered the level length significantly. Finishing a level is now much faster. With the old level length it took too long to see the new area and enemies. The reduced level length also improved the loading times.

Here is a small teaser:

 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h7Yb5vXxavM 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/79b2d80b576015a2fd2a8d013a3c92dcda03103b.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/9738fd2987340ea6f5cb84f8fb6d68ad7142ade2.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/032a98d8eb5250a81647a218c04b8d39c48c9a08.jpg


    Added new biome (Snowplanes, includes 9 new enemies and 1 new boss)
    Adjusted level length (better loading times, less crashes, faster playthrough)
    Bomb cost (300 -> 400)
    Meat drop chance per stack (2% -> 1%)
    Infusion kills (10 -> 20)

    Loot Bag gold loss (100 -> 15)


Have fun playing the new area! If there are issues or questions, let us know!

notes.title: Content Update: Over 80 new rooms, Achievements and Custom Outfits!
notes.notes:
Today we have prepared a content update.

Many of you probably know certain rooms already good enough and are not surprised by traps or enemy positions. With the new rooms the dungeons/levels feel completely new again!

In addition to the new rooms we included the achievements system into the game, there are 30 achievements.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/d4577d9aed831c999d217f0653985dd57573aacd.png

You can see all achievements here:
http://steamcommunity.com/stats/686360/achievements

Some of the achievements are hidden, so you have to figure out what must be done.

It is possible now to unlock custom cosmetic outfits. Upon completing a certain achievement you will be able to choose an outfit in the hub area.

The achievements which grant a cosmetic outfit are not hidden.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/3eb34e4eed2fb90745ec197dbc1465f1afe64a45.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/24f1b091571bf3246982b9ef6f168d97c48e34da.jpg

Some people told us that the trackpad locomotion is too slow. It feels really slow especially if you played an other game with trackpad locomotion before.

So we added a new locomotion option for this. You can now adjust the speed of trackpad locomotion (the current speed is 2.5):

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/07496de8124a26a7c119d5f83995426b66914d6d.jpg

Have fun playing the game and let is know what you think! We will always try to do our best and improve the game!

Update:


    Added 30 achievements
    Added 81 new rooms
    Added 10 cosmetic outfits (unlocked by completing achievements)
    Player movementspeed is now adjustable in the locomotion menu

notes.title: Difficulties, Combat System, Bug Fixes and More
notes.notes:
We have been listening to you all and a few things needed to be changed. So here are the changes:

We improved the melee combat system, the melee weapon now has more range and deals more damage. The scaling for swinging and wiggle have been improved as well. Wiggle has now a small cooldown. Both playstyles are now strong enough to finish the enemies and bosses. The boss loses now health if his summoned enemies are damaged.

We also added region select for multiplayer. There was an issue that people could not find each other, they were on their best region. Now if you want to play with a friend:

Make sure you both select the same region and have the same game name.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/7893a9c4fea9de6f74b8273ccf9295ec486c9c76.jpg

We added difficulty settings for single player. Difficulties can now be found on the terminal for single player.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/59d9fa9fde3520002b42da708d34a2d5f79a289c.jpg

There is now a new interface for menu, locomotion etc.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/3d15ae573a4ef2b181570c2cba66626eece3e969.jpg

We also fixed a multiplayer issue, where people would crash while looping into the second area.

Update:


    Player is now invurnable for a short time after getting hit
    Damage to summoned enemies now also deals damage to the summoner (relevant for boss fights)
    Increased range of melee weapons
    Improved AI to not let enemies walk into you
    Increased melee base damage and damage scaling when swinging
    Improved player hitbox to allow easier blocking with shield
    Adjusted enemy health scaling
    Singleplayer: Game difficulty selection
    Multiplayer: Possible to select region for private lobby (all wanting to join need to set the same region)
    Multiplayer: Made gameplay more stable (no more crashes on area switch)
    Multiplayer: Reduced player respawn time from 120 sec to 60 sec

notes.title: Save & Load System and Release
notes.notes:
Today is the big day! Dungeons & Treasure VR will be released. Thank you all for the support and the feedback. We hope all of you will have a lot of fun playing the game. Please consider leaving an honest review or feedback on steam. This will help us grow and improve the game.

We have also added one important additional feature to the game: 
You can now save your game progress with save & exit. For now saving the game only works in singleplayer.
